name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
August 11, 2009
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Reverend Beth Johnson of the Palomar Unitarian Universalist Fellowship
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Letter of Appreciation to Ernst & Young Entrepreneur of the Year 2009, Jeff McCain, CEO, McCain Traffic Supply, in recognition of his recent award for the San Diego area in the Consumer and Business Product Services Category.
P2.
Proclamations declaring August 12, 2009, "Deputy Oscar Butler Day" and August 13, 2009, "Deputy Jason Scroggins Day" in the City of Vista, in recognition of their earning the AAA Club of Southern California Auto Theft Award for recovered stolen vehicles.
P3.
Proclamation declaring August 14, 2009, "Deputy George Crysler Day" in the City of Vista, in appreciation of his professionalism and dedication to the Sheriff’s Department and making the City of Vista a safer place to live.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending May 31, 2009 (CC)
C4.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending June 30, 2009 (CC)
C5.
Cabaret License Application for El Asadero Restaurant, 1717 E. Vista Way #104 (CC)
C6.
Amendment to Regional Communications Systems Agreement (CC)
C7.
Budget Adjustment for Agua Hedionda Lagoon Watershed Study and Cost Share Agreement (CC)
C8.
Local Agency Formation Commission Application for Coe Reorganization (CC)
C9.
Summary Vacation Sewer Easements for Palomar Airport (BSD)
1.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2009- , authorizing and approving the summary vacation within Palomar Airport as owned by the County of San Diego; and
2.
Authorize staff to record the resolution with the Office of the San Diego County Recorder.
C10.
Restoration of California’s Delta and Water Supply (CC)
C11.
Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Brownfields Assessment Grant (CDC)
C12.
Exclusive Negotiating Agreement (ENA) for Restaurant Planning (CDC)
C13.
No Parking Zone on Vale Terrace Drive in NCTD Bus Stop Location (CC)
DISCUSSION
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Residential Density Bonus Ordinance, City of Vista, Applicant (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony regarding the proposed addition to the Vista Municipal Code (VMC), close the public hearing; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving the Negative Declaration for an addition to the VMC regarding a residential density bonus program; and
3.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2009- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Adding Chapter 18.88 to the Vista Municipal Code Relating to Residential Density Bonuses."
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
